admission: No recovered original, no reference replacement, no new qualification. Absence in this bounded search is not proof of permanent loss.

git_search.method: Enumerate all locally present Git objects, including unreachable objects, with cat-file --batch-all-objects; SHA256 blob bytes up to 20 MiB. Search fetched refs/reflogs for target basenames in the non-promisor repositories.
git_search.split_remote_refs: Fetched all advertised heads, tags and pull-request head refs before the final Split-Batch scan.
git_search.limitations: Not an exhaustive scan of absent promisor objects, remote deleted refs or other machines. Matching a generic basename is not original-path identity. Object counts are observations, not unique contents across clones.

workspace_search.method: Check original locations; search target basenames and hash non-symlink .log files up to 20 MiB in accessible root/workspace/admin-workspace/mount trees.
workspace_search.limitations: Excluded Git stores, caches, virtual environments, dependency trees and private agent/configuration directories. Does not cover every container layer, offline volume, renamed non-log file or symlink target. Repeated working copies are counted separately.
workspace_search.rejected_basename_matches: Generic assessment.json files belong to Qwen3.5 B0 XLSX cross-validation. Existing GDN multibuffer coverage.log belongs to the separate earlier validation, not the missing registration run.

release_search.method: Read gzip tar members without extracting or executing them; inspect every member name and SHA256 every regular member, including large files. Verify archive SHA256 against GitHub asset metadata.
release_search.limitations: Selected relevant public assets, not every organizational Release. Nested archives were not recursively unpacked. Directory references require a complete provenance-backed member inventory, not a partial filename match.

followup_checks.initial_exclusions_checked: The size exclusions above describe the initial bounded pass. Subsequently all 26 oversized logs and the one oversized dev-hub blob were hashed; none matched the eight known missing digests.
followup_checks.archive_text_method: Stream every regular member of all eight archives and search original absolute paths in UTF-8 and JSON ASCII-escaped forms, retaining overlap across chunks. No original-path mentions found.
followup_checks.git_provenance_method: Inspect JSON source/path/original_path plus SHA256 mappings in the four local Git stores. No mapping had matching original bytes; the previously declared missing digests remain unresolved.

next_recovery_requirement: Original probe directory/backup, original profiler window directories, or a provenance mapping and matching bytes from another accessible source. Do not reconstruct logs from summaries or rerun experiments as historical replacements.
hardware_and_review_gates: Unchanged; no device execution or approval-label changes.
